title: Beyond the Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Context Artifacts for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2608.22830v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying LLMs for enterprise Text-to-SQL is bottlenecked less by the model than by what context reaches it: business logic spans thousands of tables, and no model can ingest a full catalog at once. We argue that the most effective place to intervene is therefore the \emph{knowledge-base context} the model consumes, and that this context should be \emph{constructed} from historical usage rather than tuned for as a fixed input. Using a query-DAG decomposition--the same family of intermediates that enterprise benchmarks like BEAVER annotate, here recovered from production SQL--we compare the value of oracle query graphs versus retrieved knowledge-base context. In this ablation, retrieved knowledge-base context provides the largest marginal improvement when added to the full oracle graph. Building on this, we optimize a distillation procedure that turns historical query profiles into reusable SQL reference cards. On a benchmark of 5176 prod

translated_title: 超越束缚：面向企业文本到SQL的上下文工件端到端优化
translated_abstract: 摘要：将大型语言模型（LLM）部署于企业级文本到SQL任务中，其瓶颈更多地不在于模型本身，而在于输入给模型的上下文：业务逻辑跨越数千张表，而任何模型都无法一次性摄入完整的目录。因此，我们认为最有效的干预点在于模型消费的“知识库上下文”，且该上下文应基于历史使用情况“构建”而非作为固定输入进行调优。利用查询DAG分解——这一与BEAVER等企业基准所注释的中间表示同族的产物，在此从生产SQL中恢复——我们比较了Oracle查询图与检索到的知识库上下文的价值。在消融实验中，当将检索到的知识库上下文添加到完整的Oracle图时，其带来了最大的边际改进。基于此，我们优化了一个蒸馏过程，将历史查询配置文件转化为可复用的SQL参考卡片。在包含5176个生产环境的基准测试上...
tldr: 本文提出通过构建和优化基于历史查询的知识库上下文（而非固定输入），结合查询DAG分解和蒸馏过程生成SQL参考卡片，从而显著提升企业文本到SQL的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes constructing and optimizing knowledge-base context from historical queries, combined with query-DAG decomposition and distillation to generate reusable SQL reference cards, significantly improving enterprise Text-to-SQL performance.
